blocks.title: Lucas
blocks.text: I’m Lucas and I’m 16. I’m 100% honest. My friend’s new jacket is terrible, so I tell her the truth. When I’m not happy about something, I’m not quiet about it. It isn’t easy, but it’s important to be honest about your opinions. And my friends are OK about it! What else? Well, I’m clever, so when there are problems, they aren’t problems for long. I’m always fair — everyone is equal in my eyes — but maybe I’m a bit serious.

blocks.title: Emily
blocks.text: I’m Emily and I’m 15. I’m friendly and outgoing. My friends are very important to me. When my best friend is sad, I’m sad, too. So, am I caring? Yes, I am. I’m shy when I’m with adults, but when I’m with my friends, we’re very loud and fun. I’m not a calm person. When there’s a problem, or a nice surprise, I’m very sad — or very happy!

blocks.title: Sam’s profile
blocks.text:
My name’s Sam. I’m 16 and I’m from Tarifa, Spain. I’ve got a sister called Fatima — she’s 12. I’ve also got a dog, and he’s called Paco. I’m really into water sports — swimming, surfing, and kayaking. I’m interested in kitesurfing, too. I haven’t got time for other sports, but I’ve got a lot of computer games.

I’ve got quite dark skin. I’ve got short curly brown hair, and my eyes are brown, too. My favourite feature is my smile! I’m a very outgoing person. I’m also very friendly. I’ve got a lot of friends and they’re very important to me.

blocks.title: Nice to meet you
blocks.text:
Eddie: Hi, Max!
Max: Hi, Eddie.
Eddie: And — er — hi! Sorry — what’s your name?
Max: Eddie, this is Dani. She’s a new student, and she’s in our maths class.
Dani: Hi! Nice to meet you.
Eddie: Oh hi, Dani! Nice to meet you, too. So — is it your first day today? How’s it going? Are you OK?
Dani: Yeah, great thanks. I’m a bit nervous.
Max: It’s OK. We’re all friendly here.
Dani: That’s good!
Eddie: So, what’s your favourite subject?
Dani: I don’t know. Maybe PE? I’m really into sport.
Eddie: Me too! Are you interested in football?
Dani: Soccer? Yeah! What’s your favourite team?
Eddie: Chelsea.
Dani: Me too.
Max: Guys, we’ve got maths now.
Eddie: Oh yeah, come on Dani. Let’s go. So, who’s your favourite player?
Dani: Definitely Drogba. I love all the old players. What about you?

blocks.title: From Fran · Class rep!
blocks.text:
Hi Lee,

This is Fran. I’m class rep for the Year 11 students. I’m 16. I’m into parties and big groups of people — I’m very outgoing! Sometimes I’m a bit loud, but sometimes I’m quiet and calm. I’m really happy that I’m class rep this year — it’s great.

See you at the school council meeting on Thursday,
Fran

“The only way to have a friend is to be one.” — Ralph Waldo Emerson

blocks.title: From Lee · Re: Class rep!
blocks.text:
Hi Fran,

I love the quote at the end of your email! I’m class rep for the Year 10 students. I’m 15. I think you’re a fun person! I’m not very outgoing. I’m not into parties — I’m shy when I’m with new people, but I am clever. I’ve got some really good ideas for the school council this year.

See you on Thursday,
Lee

blocks.title: Yuan Li’s post
blocks.text:
I’m different at school and at home. At school, I’m shy. I’m not into answering questions. I haven’t got a loud voice — I’m very quiet. I listen. But I’m different at home with friends and family. I’m fun and I talk a lot. I’m loud!

Sometimes I’m the same with different people. People think I’m outgoing and good fun. One or two of my friends don’t know I’m a bit serious. I am quite serious, but I’m not with new friends. My good friends know that I’m fun AND serious.

Sometimes I’m the same with different people. People think I’m outgoing and good fun. One or two of my friends don’t know I’m a bit serious. I am quite serious, but I’m not with new friends. My good friends know that I’m fun AND serious.

blocks.title: The quote
blocks.text:
“Be who you are, not who the world wants you to be.” — Anonymous

Are you the same at school and at home?

How are you different with friends and with family?

blocks.title: Lucas
blocks.text: I’m Lucas and I’m 16. I’m 100% honest. My friend’s new jacket is terrible, so I tell her the truth. When I’m not happy about something, I’m not quiet about it. It isn’t easy, but it’s important to be honest about your opinions. And my friends are OK about it! What else? Well, I’m clever, so when there are problems, they aren’t problems for long. I’m always fair — everyone is equal in my eyes — but maybe I’m a bit serious.

blocks.title: Emily
blocks.text: I’m Emily and I’m 15. I’m friendly and outgoing. My friends are very important to me. When my best friend is sad, I’m sad, too. So, am I caring? Yes, I am. I’m shy when I’m with adults, but when I’m with my friends, we’re very loud and fun. I’m not a calm person. When there’s a problem, or a nice surprise, I’m very sad — or very happy!

blocks.title: Antonia and Jess
blocks.text:
Antonia: My best friend is very shy, but very generous. I am fun and outgoing.

Jess: My best friend is very loud, and very confident. I think I’m outgoing and cheerful.
